From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Coordinating SE deep-dive + customer eng time slots — NovaPulse

Hi Jorge / Nina,

Thanks for the chat earlier — really excited about NovaPulse's interest in Redwood. Per our conversation, the next step is a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive with our Solutions Engineering (SE) team and your platform engineers. Goals: surface performance numbers on your workload, validate networking/access requirements, and sketch a mutual action plan for a pilot.

Proposed agenda (attached): 1) Quick recap & success metrics (10m) 2) SE demo on representative queries (25m) 3) Live run with your sample dataset or a mocked prefix (20m) 4) Next steps (5–10m). See attached: novapulse-demo-agenda.pdf.

To make scheduling easier, can you confirm which of these windows work for your engineers (PST times shown):
- Tue Jun 1, 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Wed Jun 2, 1:00–2:15 PM PT
- Thu Jun 3, 8:00–9:15 AM PT

If these don't work, send 2–3 windows that fit your engs and procurement constraints. Also let us know whether this will include a networked test (VPC peering / private link) or just a Zoom demo — if VPC, we’ll share a checklist prior to the session.

CC'ing Stephanie (SE) and Aditya (AE) to lock resources. I’ve also attached a short SLA & runtime overview (redwood-runtime-sla.pdf) for your security team.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

- We’ll likely start as a Zoom demo; if the pilot moves forward we’ll request private networking.

If Jun 2, 1:00–2:15 PM PT works, I’ll block two SE engineers and bring a small test harness. For Jun 3 morning, can you confirm whether \"morning\" means before 9:30 PT or before 11:00 PT?

Prep items for your engs:
- Sample request patterns (file or small dataset)
- Any corp firewall/proxy policies that would block outbound traffic to api.redwood.ai
- A Slack channel or shared doc for live notes (we use a private Slack or a Google doc when customers prefer)

If you want to run a live networked test we’ll need a temporary set of keys and an IP allowlist for our side (we’ll send a checklist and temporary key request form).

I’ll tentatively hold Wed Jun 2 1–2:30 PM PT on the public calendar. Connor — can you confirm and send a calendar invite once Jorge confirms eng attendance?
